$$\max |p^2 - t^2| = 2\left(1 + \frac{1}{2025}\right) = \frac{2 \cdot 2026}{2025}.$$

$$d = \frac{4T}{2 \cdot 2026/2025} = \frac{2T \cdot 2025}{2026} = \frac{2\sqrt{2024 \cdot 2026}}{2026} = \frac{2\sqrt{2024}}{\sqrt{2026}}.$$
